fields.summary: QA- End to End Validation for TypeScript tool "SONARJS"
fields.description:
## Summary

Perform end-to-end validation of the **SONARJS** tool on a **TypeScript** repository using the Testable QA environment. Verify successful execution, metric/report accuracy, and correct platform ingestion.

### Objective

Validate that **SONARJS** integrates correctly with the Testable White Box analysis pipeline and produces the expected outputs mapped in **Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2** (White Box sheet).

Primary/secondary TypeScript tooling via eslint-plugin-sonarjs and sonarjs.

### Strategy Mapping Reference

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source file | Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2 (White Box sheet) |
| Tool | SONARJS |
| Metrics covered by this tool | **8** |
| Language focus | TypeScript |

### Metrics Covered (from Strategy v0.2)

| L3 Technique | L4 Classification | L5 Metric | TS Primary | TS Secondary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cognitive Complexity | Maintainability Evaluation | Technical Debt Impact | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Cognitive Complexity | Testability Analysis | Unit Test Complexity | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Cognitive Complexity | Risk Detection | Defect Probability | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Cognitive Complexity | Refactoring Guidance | Modularization Opportunity | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Cognitive Complexity | Code Review Support | Reviewer Fatigue Factor | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Cognitive Complexity | Testing Effort Prioritization | QA Resource Allocation | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Cognitive Complexity | Code Understandability Analysis | Human Cognitive Load | eslint-plugin-sonarjs | sonarjs |
| Path Coverage | Path Detection Testing | Path Coverage % | ESLint (eslint-scope) + nyc | js_paths |

### Validation Scope

* Verify the tool executes successfully on a representative TypeScript repository.
* Confirm raw tool output is generated without errors.
* Validate mapped metrics above are present directly or via documented derivation.
* Compare platform-ingested values with local tool execution.
* Ensure reports are stored/displayed correctly in Testable.

### Expected Result

* **SONARJS** completes execution successfully.
* All **8** mapped metrics are supported or correctly derived.
* Results display correctly in Testable without tool failure messages.

### Deliverables

* End-to-end validation results
* Execution logs
* Generated SONARJS report/output
* Screenshots of successful execution (if applicable)
